about: The engine's answer on every signed file of the diagnostic sets: the folders of Acrobat reports that are not part of the role-probe corpus. Where Acrobat's verdict for a signature is recorded in the folder's own result file, it is copied here with how the engine's answer relates to it. A rule change that moves any of these answers must edit this file on purpose.

relationships.agrees: Acrobat valid and the engine finds no forbidden change, or Acrobat invalid and the engine forbids.
relationships.no-verdict: The engine answers indeterminate rather than contradict Acrobat (a signed revision Acrobat cannot verify later changes against).
relationships.more-lenient: Acrobat reports the signature invalid and the engine does not. A known difference: inline annotations in the signed revision (see signed-inline-pages and weak-annotations).
